visual_action: A montage of clips featuring prominent Democrats and events from 2021. The video opens with Joe Biden's presidential inauguration, showing him being sworn in. It cuts to a group of new members of Congress being sworn in, then back to Biden's inauguration with Jill Biden. Subsequent shots show Biden at a CNN town hall, Kamala Harris and Nancy Pelosi standing together in front of an American flag, Harris with her husband Douglas Emhoff at what appears to be a pride event, an unidentified Black man in a suit and mask in a meeting, Harris receiving a vaccine, and Secretary of the Interior Deb Haaland speaking at a podium. The video concludes with a clip of Joe Biden speaking passionately during an address to Congress.
